title: a16z Podcast: On Data and Data Scientists in the Age of AI

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Data, data, everywhere, nor any drop to drink.
reader_summary.overview: Data, data, everywhere, nor any drop to drink. Or so would say Coleridge, if he were a big company CEO trying to use A.I. today -- because even when you have a ton of data, there's not always enough signal to get anything meaningful from AI.

key_points.text: And even then it's still not just about data operations, emphasizes SigOpt co-founder Scott Clark.
But beyond defining their goals, how do companies get over the "cold start" problem when it comes to doing more with AI in practice.
